items.title: STAT+：製藥公司的貿易集團在搜尋廣告上投入巨資影響公眾輿論
items.summary: 最近七年裡，PhRMA 估計花費了 5,900 萬美元搜尋廣告，以影響美國人對處方藥成本的看法。

items.title: STAT+: Novartis cites cases of previously unknown tumors possibly tied to its SMA 基因療法
items.summary: Novartis has acknowledged seven previously unknown instances in which tumors were found in children who were treated with its spinal muscular atrophy therapy, Zolgensma.

items.title: 醫療保險將從 340B 削減數十億美元，並在 2027 年擴大現場中立支付
items.summary: Regulators finalized a rule Wednesday that would slash payments for drugs in the controversial 340B program and equalize some payments between care sites. Hospitals railed against the rule.

items.title: Alethio 籌集 9000 萬美元用於治療罕見血癌
items.summary: The startup is working on a medicine one of its investors claimed could have a broader reach than other approved drugs for a group of conditions known as myeloproliferative neoplasms.

items.summary: 桑德斯可以利用他在製定 美國食藥局（FDA） 資助法案中的作用來推動改革。
